fusions.name: Thump and Go
fusions.desc: A quick lash at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Flushed Out
fusions.desc: Fires a strand at the first enemy it meets, dealing 28 damage. Every hit is a critical hit. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Flat Out
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 45% for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Springing Gait
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%.
